items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Barão de Cocais (MG) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 148,744.52; proposals close Dec 4, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
